# Synthetic board-review examples

These documents are fictional fixtures for the board-quality contract. Their item availability and image paths are test inputs, not observations of a real app or evidence of a product verdict. Both keep Function and UI UNGRADED.

`positive.json` requests the missing local item needed to test the supplied 1–99 quantity requirement. `unsupported-policy.json` changes only the requested action to accept 999 and remove rejection of 100. Both are structurally valid; the second must fail independent source-fidelity review. A deterministic text/shape check is not expected to infer that product-policy conflict.
